items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 127:1
items.html: (To the question) What are Rachel and Leah? It is known that ZA in its entirety is built from the Mochin of Ima. And just as Ima, who is Bina, was divided into GAR and ZAT, whose GAR are the aspect of the upper Aba and Ima, which are covered Hassadim that reject Hochma, and whose ZAT are the aspect of Israel-Saba and Tevunah, which are revealed Hassadim in the illumination of Hochma; so ZA, which is built from Ima, is in the secret of "And I am a plain man": from the chest and above the aspect of the GAR of Ima illuminates in it, namely, the aspect of covered Hassadim, and from the chest and below the aspect of the ZAT of Bina illuminates in it, which are revealed Hassadim. And since they are almost two aspects opposite to one another, therefore the verse called him by the name "a plain man," and he is also called "helek" [part] because he is a part of the hairs, as is known.
